text:
olivia: Hey @sam_dealdesk — Aperture Health asked for a POC price. 6-week pilot, 3 dedicated GPUs, ~500k tokens/day. They're requesting 45% off standard dedicated rate. Need deal desk OK to propose.

sam_dealdesk: What's the expected conversion ARR or commit if they buy after pilot? Any chance of a 12-mo renewal commit?

olivia: If pilot converts they'd commit to ~12k GPU-hours/mo for 12 months (~$165k/mo list). Pilot is try-and-buy; our AE thinks ~60% conversion probability.

jordan_se: Quick tech Q — pilot requires HIPAA logging + private VPC and they want custom kernel tuning. Can Dedicated support that without extra infra uplift?

lee_legal: HIPAA/BAA required. Legal needs data flow diagram, subprocessors list, and SOC2 cert copy. Can't sign pricing until we have the security package.

maria_finance: 45% off on list leaves ~12% gross margin at current ops cost — that's pretty thin. Suggest structuring as a time‑bound pilot credit vs permanent discount. Maybe 30% off on conversion with a rebate if they convert.

alex_cro: :thinking_face: We should be competitive for a healthcare reference. Recommend approving up to 40% for the 6-week pilot if conversion is tied to a 9‑month minimum commit. Finance to confirm break‑even.

sam_dealdesk: Proposed structure: pilot billed at list but we apply a one‑time credit equal to 40% of pilot list for up to 6 weeks; conversion contingent on a 9‑month commit at 30% off with a $125k/mo minimum. Deal desk approve?

maria_finance: I can approve a one‑time credit equivalent to 40% off for max 6 weeks (recorded as credit on first invoice after pilot). For conversion terms: firm 30% off with min $125k/mo; require forecast + upfront payment or shorter payment terms.

olivia: Thanks — I'll present that. I'll tell them: pilot credit 40%, conversion 30% off with 9mo/$125k monthly min. CC'ing @lee_legal for BAA and @jordan_se for infra scoping. Next step I'll attach draft quote. /me prepping quote now

revenue-bot: Quote created: Q-2026-1457 (private link: https://app.revenue.redwood/quotes/Q-2026-1457) :white_check_mark:

lee_legal: Got the quote id. I'll start the BAA draft and request SOC2 & subprocessors list. @olivia please upload docs to the drive and share link here.

jordan_se: I'll scope infra changes and give an ops delta. FYI custom kernel tuning may add a one‑time engineering/ops fee (~$12k) depending on model.

olivia: Uploaded docs: https://redwood.share/apt-health/hipaa-pkg. Draft quote snippet below:
```yaml
pilot:
  duration: 6 weeks
  credit: 40% of list
conversion_offer:
  term: 9 months
  min_monthly_commit: $125000
  discount: 30%
notes: pilot credit applied on first invoice after conversion
```
I'll update the quote after legal + finance confirm wording.

sam_dealdesk: :thumbsup: Deal desk marks this as conditionally approved. Finance + Legal to finalize paperwork and revenue ops to issue final quote.

alex_cro: I approve the conditional structure. If they agree to multi‑year + reference case we can revisit for an uplift. Proceed.
